describes: Locked visual baseline for the Anesthesia Coverage Grid Calculator. Future aesthetic-audit runs diff the live code against this snapshot and flag any drift. Update only on a fresh aesthetic checkpoint approved by Gabriel.

anesthesiologist.note: PRD §7.6. Card border, badge accent, supervision count chip.

crna.note: PRD §7.6. Pill background, chip dot, accent button.

overRatioViolation.note: PRD §7.6. Red border when supervisionCount > ratioCap.

required.note: PRD §5 + §7.5. Always rendered exactly as written here in the visible UI.

forbiddenInRenderedUi.context: Any user-visible label, button text, tooltip, or chip caption.
allowedIn: Internal TypeScript identifiers (e.g. CoverageStyle 'md_heavy', enum values).
forbiddenInRenderedUi.note: PRD §5. Internal types may keep physician/md enums for FloorRunner type compatibility; rendered UI never does.

rules.description: Each site is a horizontal lane with a left-edge header carrying icon + name + distance indicator.
Anesthesiologist = larger rectangular card with role badge + supervision count. CRNA = smaller pill.
Cross-site supervision is rendered with a dashed purple connector + destination site badge.
Cross-site CRNAs carry a destination-site badge so the link reads inside the chip alone.
Float lane is pinned last; floats render as outlined (dashed-gray, transparent bg) cards.
UI labels are ALWAYS 'Anesthesiologist' and 'CRNA' in rendered JSX. Never 'MD' in user-visible text.
Amber #f59e0b for Anesthesiologists, cyan #0ea5e9 for CRNAs, purple #a855f7 for cross-site, red #ef4444 for over-ratio.

warnTokens.note: Tailwind blue token — should be cyan.

rules.description: Toggle bar is sticky at the top of the canvas. Grid re-solves with a 200ms shimmer animation.
FTE panel is the persistent right-rail card with 3 numbers (Anesthesiologists, CRNAs, Backup-call FTE) each with Worst/Expected tabs.

driftWatchList: Tailwind blue tokens (text-blue-500, bg-blue-500) used instead of cyan-500.
New buttons or chips with literal 'MD' text in JSX (e.g. 'MD-heavy', 'MD pool', 'solo MD').
Lane header width drift: a contributor changes width: 160 to width: 180 or similar.
Card min-width drift: minWidth: 220 nudged to 240/200.
Shimmer duration drift: 200ms changed to 150/300ms during a tweak.
Cross-site color swapped from #a855f7 to a different purple (e.g. #9333ea, #c084fc).
Float lane rendered with solid (filled) cards instead of dashed outlined.
FTE panel converted from sticky to scrolling (loses persistence).
